newsitem.title: CANADA: Three guards taken hostage at Quebec prison.
newsitem.headline: Three guards taken hostage at Quebec prison.

text.p: Prisoners at a provincial detention centre in Valleyfield are holding three guards hostage, Quebec Provincial Police spokesman Gerard Carrier said early Friday.
He said the guards were taken prisoner about 11 p.m. Thursday (0300 GMT) and provincial police were called to the scene.
"We are trying to get in touch with the prisoners. We don't have any information yet about whether there were injuries or whether weapons were involved," Carrier said.
He said the guards were being held on the third floor of the prison, and that a total 60 prisoners were inside the facility.
Valleyfield is about 18 miles (30 kms) south of Montreal.
